items.title: Special right to terminate contract due to price increase
items.quote: Sie können binnen drei Monaten ab Zugang dieses Schreibens kostenfrei kündigen; der Vertrag endet frühestens mit Wirksamwerden der Änderung.
items.computation: The letter is dated Fri 05.12.2025 and was sent by ordinary post; the exact day it reached Mara Beispiel (Zugang) is not stated. Muster Mobil GmbH is a private company, not an authority, so the statutory 3-/4-day deemed-delivery fiction for administrative letters does not apply; instead the usual assumption for domestic post (about 1-3 days) is used, so Zugang is assumed on Mon 08.12.2025 (the earliest plausible date). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt (08.12.2025) is not counted, so the 3-month period starts running on 09.12.2025. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of months ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the start day, i.e. 08.03.2026, which is a Sunday. Notice/cancellation deadlines are not extended to the next business day (BGH III ZR 172/04) - the cancellation must reach the provider by that calendar date, so to be safe it should arrive on or before Fri 06.03.2026. Because the actual delivery date of the letter is an assumption, the true deadline could fall later if the letter arrived after 08.12.2025.
